i needed to know how much of the user's tp it'd remove (which is still kinda nebulous), and how much of that tp would be transferred to the target (which i had assumed to be 100%, but i dont know if that 80-100% was actually for the player as i had asked for, or for the target as it sounds like you meant)
Put this in the notebox for the skill. the notetag is from the skill core, but if youre using skill rewards then youre already using it
Code:
<After Eval>
var tpChange = Math.ceil(user.tp*(.8+user.level/500));
user.gainTp(-tpChange)
target.gainTp(tpChange)
</After Eval>
itll remove a percentage of tp from the user based on their level. the target will gain that amount of tp the user lost. the amount lost starts at 80% and increases by +.2% per level so that by the time the user hits lv 100 itll be 100%
